title: Dealer Dynamics — Sales Insight Navigator
summary: Enterprise-grade sales analytics platform featuring real-time GPS tracking, advanced behavioral analysis, and automated report generation to deliver actionable business insights and optimize field operations.
problem: Field sales teams lacked visibility into their own performance. Manual tracking was inconsistent and territory coverage was unmeasured, leading to missed opportunities and duplicated effort.
solution: Built a comprehensive analytics platform with real-time GPS tracking, territory coverage analysis, performance scorecards, and automated opportunity identification — all presented in an interactive dashboard.
achievements: 35% improvement in field sales team efficiency
Real-time GPS tracking with territory coverage heatmaps
Automated performance scorecards replacing weekly manual reports
Predictive opportunity identification from behavioral patterns

features.title: Core Features
features.content: Real-time GPS tracking and route visualization; territory coverage analysis with heatmaps; daily/weekly automated performance reports; opportunity scoring based on visit history and customer clustering; alert system for territory gaps.
